tools.name: find_space
tools.description: Search the public VTC Space directory by name, handle, description or tag (no login). Returns space_id for the other public tools.

tools.name: get_space_public_profile
tools.description: Public profile of one Space (description, website, networks) and which AI Support modes it offers guests.

tools.name: ask_space_public
tools.description: Ask a Space's public AI Support a question in plain text (e.g. "what are the options for solar panels"). Answers only from the Space's AI documents and collections the Space marked 'Public to AI Support' (public fields only). Same route as the Space's guest support chat; the Space pays for answers.

tools.name: list_space_public_documents
tools.description: List the documents a Space's public AI Support uses (names and types only).

tools.name: read_public_collection
tools.description: Read documents from a Space collection that the Space explicitly shared as public (public-read). Optional text filter matched over the returned rows. Private collections return "not found or not public".

tools.name: list_network_public_apps
tools.description: Public app catalog shown to members of a VTC network (e.g. network id 1 = VTC).

tools.name: list_developer_catalog
tools.description: Public ZAPI developer catalog of app-facing API services (no auth).

tools.name: search_public
tools.description: Search public people by username, and public spaces or networks by name or username (no login). Networks are spaces with kind "network". Use a space or network id with set_guest_context.

tools.name: search_public_spaces
tools.description: Find public VTC Spaces by space name or space username/slug (no login). Use the returned id with set_guest_context.

tools.name: search_public_people
tools.description: Find public people by username (optional leading @). No login. People who opted out of search, or who are only in a private network, are omitted. Email is not searchable.

tools.name: set_guest_context
tools.description: Bind a Space for guest/public tools (no login). Accepts a numeric id, public slug (dexi), or a name that matches one public space. Prefer search_public_spaces when the name may match several spaces.

tools.name: list_guest_public_apps
tools.description: List apps on a Space dashboard that allow guest browse (public_guest_access=yes). Uses public ZAPI — no Space JWT.

tools.name: describe_public_app_surface
tools.description: AI manifest plus guest/public read hints for one app (module_code). No Space JWT required.

tools.name: list_public_collection_documents
tools.description: Read documents from a collection the Space marked public-read (ZAPI). No JWT.

tools.name: fetch_app_public_route
tools.description: GET an allowlisted HTTPS public API URL on *.apps.vtc.com (path must include /public). No JWT.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_public_people, fetch_app_public_route · Private data: ask_space_public, list_space_public_documents, read_public_collection, search_public_people, list_public_collection_documents · Public sink: search_public_people.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_public_people, fetch_app_public_route · Private data: ask_space_public, list_space_public_documents, read_public_collection, search_public_people, list_public_collection_documents · Public sink: search_public_people

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
